product_metadata.title: Egg Slicer for Hard Boiled Eggs - 3 Slice Modes, Handy Heavy Duty Stainless Steel Egg Cutter - Kitchen Dicer for Strawberry, Mushroom, Grape, Cherry Tomato
features: Utilization: The egg slicer is designed for processing hard-boiled eggs. This device will greatly simplify the preparation of food and save your time. Now you don't have to put efforts trying to make your slices or cubes the same size, the egg cutter will do it for you

Materials and Functions: The hard boiled egg cutter is made of super quality plastic and has sharp stainless steel blades. The tool has 3 different modes to slice eggs, as well as a receptacle container for processed foods. Thanks to the container, the eggs will not fall apart, and you can also easily add them to the dish by simply pouring the contents right out of the container

Neat Slicing: With our hard boiled egg slicer, you can nicely and neatly cut eggs for a salad, sandwich, or any other dish, as well as for decorating foods. Now your dish will look like one from the Chef within just a few minutes

Easy to Use and Care: Using the egg cutting tool is very easy. Just place the peeled egg on the surface, close it, and - all done! Washing the strawberry slicer is just as easy, you can rinse it with water or put it into the dishwasher

Universal Kitchen Gadget: The egg dicer for hard boiled eggs is a universal and indispensable tool in daily life. You can use it not only for eggs, but also for strawberries, bananas, apples, grapes, lime, lemon, mushrooms, cherry tomatoes, and other non-solid foods. Now, every dish will not only taste delicious but also look amazing! Surprise your kids and loved ones by giving their favorite dishes an absolutely new and beautiful look
